name: Lev development protocol
temperatures: one per depth, fitted on decision-v7 calibration (scripts/depth_rows.py rows; analysis/adaptive_depth.py), frozen

breadth-v1-development.condition: only if the local rebuild matches the manifest sha256 9aad8f4a...

gates.where: eval-v1 development, pooled over its tiers, answerable rows only: unknowable rows and report_only rows (StrategyQA) are excluded
gates.G1: adaptive accuracy - depth 4 accuracy >= -1 pp, paired 95% CI lower bound > -2 pp, question cost <= 0.70
gates.G2: adaptive - random escalation with the same stop distribution: paired 95% CI lower bound > 0
gates.G3: adaptive - fixed-depth frontier at the same question cost: paired 95% CI lower bound > 0
gates.ci: paired bootstrap over record groups, 2,000 resamples, seed 0
gates.decision: phase 2 passes when the primary stopper passes G1-G3 on the pooled panel; a tier where it fails is reported as a boundary condition, not re-tuned

reported_not_gated: per tier (id / near / deep / far) and per source: fixed-depth accuracy, adaptive accuracy and cost, deltas vs depth 4 and vs the frontier
per difficulty k (generated families; BoardgameQA, StepGame, CLadder): adaptive cost and accuracy by k, to answer whether harder items go deeper
seen_s31 split: rows whose source is in S31 vs not
unknowable tier: rate of confident answers (top probability >= 0.9) per fixed depth and under the adaptive stops
report_only (StrategyQA): the same table as a tier
breadth-v1 development, if rebuilt: the same tables
the control stopper (fit calibration) on every panel
not_read: decision-v7 / transfer-v9 / hard-v1 test: phase 5 only
